happo-no-yu.lead: Hakuba, Kitaazumi, Nagano. Among Japan's strongest alkaline simple springs — natural peeling beauty bath. TEL 0261-72-5705 (official — verify).

mimizuku.lead: Hakuba Hokujo area. Strong alkaline water for muscle recovery after skiing. TEL 0261-72-6542 (official — verify).
mimizuku.imgAlt: Indoor bath at Mimizuku-no-Yu — local Hakuba spring

usagidaira.title: Usagidaira Terrace
usagidaira.lead: 4487-12 Hokujo, Hakuba — inside Happo-One resort. Summit terrace restaurant with Northern Alps views — a sunny-day lunch classic. TEL 0261-72-3280 (official — verify).
usagidaira.imgAlt: Northern Alps view from Usagidaira Terrace — on-mountain restaurant

blizzard.title: BLIZZARD
blizzard.lead: 4257 Hokujo, Hakuba. Wood-oven pizza by an international chef — resort-style dinner with global vibes. TEL 0261-85-0017 (official — verify).
blizzard.imgAlt: Wood-fired pizza at BLIZZARD — Hakuba international dining

powder.title: Premium powder at scale
powder.body: 760–1,831 m elevation across 220 ha — stable snowfall (Jan ~210 cm, Feb ~240 cm monthly average). Signature advanced runs include Riesen Slalom and Skyline. Gondolas may close in high wind (check official ops).

nagano.title: ~64 minutes from Nagano
nagano.body: ~64 min by car from JR Nagano — realistic weekend skiing via Hokuriku Shinkansen. Rent at Nagano Station to hub Hakuba Valley's 5–10 resorts plus onsen and dining loops.

olympic.title: Olympic legacy
olympic.body: 1998 Nagano Winter Games alpine venue — Olympic Courses I & II (up to 35°) still in service. A new 10-person gondola targeting December 2027 will boost capacity (official — verify).
